# Ironclad Tech

> Ironclad Tech is a Pakistan-based BPO (business process outsourcing) provider delivering Healthcare BPO, Insurance Outsourcing, AI Voice Solutions, Customer Support, Virtual Assistants, Lead Generation, Back Office, and Digital Solutions to businesses worldwide. Teams are dedicated, HIPAA-aware, and typically onboard within two weeks.

## Services

- [Healthcare BPO](https://www.getironcladtech.com/healthcare-bpo): Appointment scheduling, patient support, medical billing assistance and revenue cycle back-office support.
- [Insurance Outsourcing](https://www.getironcladtech.com/insurance-outsourcing): ACA enrollment, Medicare assistance, Final Expense campaigns, lead verification and policy servicing.
- [AI Voice Solutions](https://www.getironcladtech.com/ai-voice-solutions): AI voice agents, automation and intelligent call routing for 24/7 customer engagement.
- [Customer Support](https://www.getironcladtech.com/customer-support): Inbound, outbound, live chat and email support from trained, dedicated agents.
- [Virtual Assistants](https://www.getironcladtech.com/virtual-assistants): Scheduling, inbox management, research and administrative support.
- [Lead Generation](https://www.getironcladtech.com/lead-generation): Appointment setting, sales support and business development outsourcing.
- [Back Office](https://www.getironcladtech.com/back-office): Data entry, CRM management and administrative back-office outsourcing.
- [Digital Solutions](https://www.getironcladtech.com/digital-solutions): Automation, business process improvement and technology support.

## Notes

- Ironclad Tech describes its healthcare data handling as "HIPAA-aware," not "HIPAA-compliant."
- Case study figures are clearly labeled as illustrative examples where real, client-verified results are not yet published. No fabricated statistics are used anywhere on this site.
